description_en: Adds a service resource to an endpoint service by calling the AttachResourceToVpcEndpointService operation
description_zh: 调用AttachResourceToVpcEndpointService接口，为终端节点服务添加服务资源
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink attach-resource-to-vpc-endpoint-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type slb --resource-id lb-hp32z1wp5peaoox2q0000 --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachResourceToVpcEndpointService

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint service to which you want to add a service resource.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要添加服务资源的终端节点服务所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The EPS resource type. Valid values:

slb: The service resource type is Classic Load Balancer (CLB).
alb: The service resource type is Application Load Balancer (ALB).
nlb: The service resource type is Network Load Balancer (NLB).
gwlb: The service resource type is Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB)
parameters.help_zh:
服务资源类型。取值：

slb：表示服务资源类型为传统型负载均衡CLB（Classic Load Balancer）。
alb：表示服务资源类型为应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。
nlb：表示服务资源类型为网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer ）。
gwlb : 表示服务资源类型为网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The zone of the service resource. This parameter is required when the service resource is an ALB, NLB, or GWLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 服务资源所属的可用区。服务资源为ALB/NLB/GWLB时，ZoneId为需要填写
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The endpoint service to which you want to add a service resource
parameters.help_zh: 要添加服务资源的终端节点服务
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without adding the service resource. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会添加服务资源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
